h: Tinubu names Festus Keyamo to head air mobilisation for his 2027 campaign
p: President Tinubu has appointed Aviation Minister Festus Keyamo to lead the Directorate of Air Mobilisation in the APC presidential campaign council, according to a statement from his media adviser. The FAAN managing director, Olubunmi Kuku, is named a deputy director. The directorate will handle air travel and logistics across the six geopolitical zones.
more: Engr. Farouk Ahmed Umar is the second deputy director.
The APC flagged off its re-election campaign in Kaduna over the weekend.
The NDC has also named its own campaign council.
